result.topic_en: Scattered calculations: two tables of numbers ending in 5 paired with small counts, headed by the Gaussian integers 5+8i and 5+28i (apparently related to biquadratic residues), together with angle computations (173°10'18") and a table of signed pairwise differences labelled ab, ac, ad, etc.

methods.what: Tabulation of counts against multiples of 5 (odd multiples) for the Gaussian integer 5+8i, apparently counting residues/lattice points up to a bound
Same type of tabulation of counts for the Gaussian integer 5+28i
Antisymmetric table of pairwise differences between four quantities a, b, c, d (xy = -yx)
Angle computation in degrees, minutes, seconds
